tools.name: x_search

Search tweets with the full operator filter set, or search user profiles by keyword.

Guidance: type=search-tweets (default): q required, resultsLimit MANDATORY (billed per tweet returned). Supports the full filter set: fromUser, language, sinceDate/untilDate, mediaType, minFaves, verifiedOnly, exac

tools.name: x_timeline

Guidance: kind selects the timeline: user-tweets|user-replies|user-likes|user-media|user-mentions|followers|following|verified-followers (id = user) or tweet-replies|tweet-quotes|tweet-thread|twee

tools.name: x_lists
tools.description:
Read X list timelines, members, and followers.

Guidance: kind=tweets|members|followers; id = list ID. resultsLimit is MANDATORY — billed per item returned. tweets supports sinceTime/untilTime and includeReplies.

tools.name: x_communities

Community info, members, moderators, tweets, and in-community search.

Guidance: kind=info (fixed price) or members|moderators|tweets|search (per-item — resultsLimit MANDATORY). id = community ID. search additionally requires q.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x_read, x_timeline, x_extract, x_monitor, x_write, x_inbox · Private data: x_read, x_monitor, x_draws, x_write, x_inbox, x_profile, x_community · Public sink: x_read, x_search, x_timeline, x_extract, x_monitor, x_draws, x_write, x_compose · Destructive: x_draws, x_write, x_community.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x_read, x_timeline, x_extract, x_monitor, x_write, x_inbox · Private data: x_read, x_monitor, x_draws, x_write, x_inbox, x_profile, x_community · Public sink: x_read, x_search, x_timeline, x_extract, x_monitor, x_draws, x_write, x_compose · Destructive: x_draws, x_write, x_community

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
